name: SmartCredit
notes: research inconclusive: SmartCredit Leveraged Lido module mentioned as exploited but no detailed postmortem found
keep_reason: Likely contract bug in leveraged Lido module but root cause unverified

name: Wasabi Perps
notes: Deployer key compromise; attacker granted ADMIN_ROLE to malicious helper, used UUPS upgrade to replace vault impl and drain funds
keep_reason: Off-chain key compromise (deployer EOA); no contract bug — UUPS worked as designed

name: Syndicate
notes: Private key for bridge upgrader leaked from password manager; attacker upgraded bridge proxy to malicious impl and minted/drained SYND
keep_reason: Private key leak / opsec failure not a Solidity contract bug

name: JUDAO
notes: Flashloan-funded price manipulation of PancakeSwap V2 BUSD-JUDAO pair; protocol used spot reserves as price source
keep_reason: On-chain price-oracle vulnerability

name: Gondi V3
notes: PurchaseBundler in Sell&Repay omitted msg.sender/owner check, letting attacker reuse victims' setApprovalForAll to transferFrom NFTs
keep_reason: Missing authorization check in Solidity contract

name: Wise Lending V2
notes: Wise Lending repeated victim of flashloan-driven share-price/oracle manipulation via stETH/ETH peg swing in pool oracle
keep_reason: Oracle/share-price manipulation vector

name: Veil Cash
notes: Groth16 verifier delta2==gamma2==G2 generator (trusted setup skipped/placeholder); pairing trivially satisfied so any proof valid
keep_reason: On-chain ZK verifier misconfiguration enables forged proofs

name: Revert Lend
notes: research inconclusive: no specific postmortem located; Revert V3Vault uses UniV3 LP collateral, possibly fee/valuation issue
keep_reason: Likely Solidity-level vault accounting bug

name: Aperture LM
notes: Arbitrary-call vuln in 0x67b34120(); user-controlled target+calldata in low-level call abused victims' ERC20/NFT approvals via transferFrom
keep_reason: Missing target/selector validation in Solidity

name: Polycule
notes: Off-chain custodial Telegram bot: SSRF via URL parsing + forged copy-trade signals + reversibly-encrypted private keys on backend
keep_reason: Off-chain backend compromise of custodial bot — not a Solidity contract bug

name: Panoptic V1.1
notes: Position-list fingerprint used XOR; hash collisions allowed spoofing position ownership and bypassing collateral checks (whitehat rescue)
keep_reason: Solidity bug in position accounting; whitehat saved funds

name: PRXVT
notes: research inconclusive: details thin; reportedly used CREATE2 to deterministically generate many addresses to bypass per-address claim caps
keep_reason: Tokenomics/airdrop sybil exploit on-chain

name: Yearn Ether
notes: Unchecked arithmetic + cached-supply desync in _calc_supply; bootstrap path re-entered with 16 wei minted 2.35e56 yETH LP via underflow
keep_reason: Solidity arithmetic/accounting bug in stableswap solver

name: Hyperdrive HL
notes: Router accepted arbitrary calls to whitelisted contracts with users' excessive approvals; attacker triggered repeated transferFrom drains
keep_reason: Missing call-target/selector restriction in router contract

name: Coinbase
notes: Coinbase fee wallet granted ERC20 allowances to permissionless 0x Settler contract; MEV bot used those allowances to transferFrom and swap
keep_reason: Off-chain ops mistake (approval to wrong address); no contract bug

name: numa.
notes: VaultManager collateral-valuation flaw: flash-mint of nuBTC inflated synthValueInEth, undercollateralizing cNuma users for liquidation
keep_reason: Solidity accounting bug enabling self-liquidation profit

name: Usual USD0
notes: USD0++ unwrap to USD0 at fixed 1:1 in vault while DEX price diverged; capped arbitrage drained vault profit margin
keep_reason: On-chain pricing/design oversight in vault unwrap

name: Impermax V3
notes: UniV3 LP collateral valuation counted uncollected fees; attacker self-generated fees via swaps then borrowed and self-liquidated for bad debt
keep_reason: Solidity collateral valuation bug

name: Bitcoin Mission
notes: research inconclusive: original technique suggests unrestricted overPaper() admin/mint function but no public postmortem located
keep_reason: Likely missing access control on privileged function

name: Abracadabra Spell
notes: GMX-integrated cauldron: failed GMX deposit left order in OrderAgent; attacker self-liquidated then borrowed against the wiped position
keep_reason: State-tracking bug across GMX integration

name: four.meme
notes: Token migration to PancakeSwap v3 used pool's existing price; attacker front-ran by pre-creating pool with skewed price, drained migrated LP
keep_reason: On-chain price-source manipulation at migration

name: Sirio Finance
notes: research inconclusive: Sirio Hedera lender hit via Bonzo flashloans then borrow+withdraw; specific mechanic not publicly disclosed
keep_reason: On-chain lending exploit but exact root cause undisclosed

name: Vestra DAO
notes: unStake() lacked isActive check; attacker repeatedly called it on already-unstaked position, harvesting 20k VSTR yield each call
keep_reason: Missing state validation in Solidity staking

name: Lava
notes: research inconclusive: only March 2024 Lava Lending flashloan ($340k) documented; Oct 2024 $130k Arbitrum incident details not located
keep_reason: On-chain flashloan exploit but root cause unverified

name: Ronin Bridge
notes: V2 upgrade ran initializeV4 but skipped initializeV3, leaving _totalOperatorWeight=0 and minVoteWeight=0; any signature passed bridge
keep_reason: Classic upgrade initialization bug; whitehat-recovered

name: DeltaPrime
notes: July 2024 DeltaPrime: misconfiguration allowed account takeover, repaying loans and withdrawing collateral (smaller precursor to Sept key leak)
keep_reason: Solidity access-control / config bug

name: Balancer V2
notes: ERC4626 LinearPool rounding-down combined with rate reset on 0 BPT supply; flashSwap pumped rate to drain Boosted Pools (whitehat $130k bounty)
keep_reason: Solidity rounding/precision bug in BoostedPool math

name: LeetSwap
notes: _transferFeesSupportingTaxTokens (and other internal fee functions) left external/public, letting anyone manipulate pool reserves and drain WETH
keep_reason: Missing internal/access modifier on fee function

name: pNetwork
notes: pGALA bridge BSC-side misconfiguration allowed unauthorized minting; pNetwork pre-emptively minted 28.4B pGALA to drain PCS pool defensively
keep_reason: On-chain bridge config flaw enabling unauthorized mint
